name: Cabinets Don`t  Cry
detailed_description:
"Cabinets Don’t Cry" – a Sci-Fi Investigation point& click Thriller

You are a Special Investigations Agent dispatched to a picturesque remote town to unravel the mystery behind... cabinets, now a symbol of a series of bizarre disappearances among locals.  

Classic witness interrogations blend seamlessly with gameplay featuring intricate gadgets for evidence detection and collection. Analyze and piece together clues on your investigation board to avoid false surveillance and stay on the straight and narrow.

STEALTH plays a role: how truthful are your interviewees? During the quietest nights, you might uncover the most "screaming" evidence.  

Prepare to disregard moral boundaries in the heat of the pursuit and the race to solve enigmas — after all, the stakes are a civilization-scale catastrophe!  

More Than Just a Detective Story:  

- Memorable, often absurd characters – true-to-life and unpredictable!  

- Diverse locations brimming with detailed architecture and vibrant nature.  

- Branching narrative paths with quests that adapt to your choices.  

- Sci-fi elements – a synthesized world blending cutting-edge tech and scientific method
